_shape: throwback-era-shape v1 · one file per course · eras keyed by year · story cards are medium-agnostic; the era's skin decides how they are drawn (newspaper now; radio, film, TV, web later) · fields starting with _ never render
_rules: No accounts, no student data, no saved state. Nothing typed is kept. The kid's log is on paper in the Casefile A packet.
Rooms and silhouettes are AI-made and carry the AI-made label. Archival images are real, dated and credited and carry the archival label. A president's image is a real, sourced image, never AI-made.

Every quotation points to a record. Adapted text says (adapted). Invented text is never a quotation. A president's card uses words he said or signed, cut from the public record, or a plain paraphrase of it.
Content words come from Sam through Danny with BK's yes. Josh owns the container fields only: era ids, panel rectangles, unlock flags, skin ids, image paths.

name.label: Throwback
name.subtitle: Pick a moment. See where the seven Threads stood, and what it was like to be your age then.
name._note: BK ruled 22:38: 'Throwback is the name.' It is one data slot.

young_person_headings._note: Sam proposes 5-6 fixed headings, the same in every era, with a 'now' column last (BK 22:07). These six are Josh's placeholders to size the table, not a proposal.

census_categories._note: Fixed categories every era so change can be tracked (BK 21:48, item 4). Placeholders to size the strip; Sam and Danny settle the real list and the source for each number.

units._note: Which eras a unit's two-frame view shows. 1801 is shared: the end of 11.2 and the start of 11.3A. 'here' comes from the Arena manifest's current_unit, like the Threads map; no field here.

eras._note: Listed so the selector shows the pattern (a moment that exists but isn't built). No room image yet. Shown and labeled, never hidden (CONVENTIONS §7).

skin._note: Masthead and edition line are placeholders. Sam names the paper; it must not borrow a real paper's name.
